## LC123 v1.50.0

[github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC123_nodes](https://github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC123_nodes)

| Node | What it does |
|---|---|
| **CivitAI 🚩🔪** | Strips flagged terms from a prompt using a compliance list, as an aid only (you are still responsible for CivitAI's terms). Off until you switch it on. |
| **LC Advanced Folder 📂** | Builds separate filename and path outputs for Image Saver style nodes, with optional prefix-in-path and timestamp. |
| **LC Anima Regional Inline Canvas** | Paint RGB regions on the node and get a separate conditioning and mask for each region, for Anima regional prompting. |
| **LC Any Empty Bool** | Outputs true if any connected input is empty, muted or bypassed. |
| **LC Any Empty Float** | Runs the same empty test as Any Empty Bool and outputs an empty and a not-empty float. |
| **LC Any Empty Int** | Runs the same empty test as Any Empty Bool and outputs an empty and a not-empty integer. |
| **LC Any Index Switch** | Passes through the input at the chosen index and ignores the other slots. |
| **LC AnySwitch** | Picks the first connected input out of 2 to 20 and locks to its type. |
| **LC Apply LoRA Stack 🎚️** | Applies a LORA_STACK from LC LoRA Loader Stack (or any pack) to model and/or clip. |
| **LC Apply LUT** | Applies a .cube 3D LUT from models/luts with a strength from 0 to 2. Starts on LC Crushed Blacks at 0.3. |
| **LC Aspect Ratio Pipe (In/Edit)** | Packs image, mask, size, latent, batch and resolution into an LC_PIPE, or edits one, overwriting only the wired sockets. |
| **LC Aspect Ratio Pipe Out** | Unpacks the aspect ratio fields of an LC_PIPE into separate sockets and passes the pipe on. |
| **📐 LC Aspect Ratio Simplifier** | Resizes an image and/or mask to a target size and outputs image, mask, size, empty latent and batch. |
| **📐 LC Aspect Ratio Simplifier (pipe)** | Does the same as the Aspect Ratio Simplifier and adds a pipe output for Get/Set. |
| **LC Auto White Balance** | Corrects white balance automatically with a choice of algorithm, a strength blend and a before/after wipe. |
| **LC Basic Scheduler** | Outputs sigmas for the full step count (no denoise), made to feed LC Split Sigmas (Advanced) for dual-pass sampling. |
| **LC Batch Image 🖼️** | Batches images from auto-growing slots, ignoring muted or missing ones and resizing later images to the first. |
| **LC Bloom** | Adds a glow from the bright areas in Bloom, Pro-Mist (diffusion filter) or Halation (film edge glow) mode. |
| **LC Boolean** | Turns a boolean, int or float into a clean true/false and shows it on the node. |
| **LC Boolean Flip** | Outputs the opposite of its toggle. |
| **LC Boolean Switch** | Picks the on_true or on_false input (any type) based on a boolean. |
| **LC Boolean Value** | A plain boolean toggle you can wire anywhere. |
| **LC Bypass Relay** | Gathers nodes on its left so a hub can mute or bypass all of them together through OPT_CONNECTION. |
| **LC Bypasser** | Bypasses linked nodes from one place with toggles or BOOLEAN inputs. |
| **LC Bypasser Panel** | A widgets-only remote for LC Bypasser, LC Mute or LC Groups Bypasser. |
| **🗒️LC Camera** | Sets camera framing and depth of field for a prompt from distance and angle presets. |
| **LC Chromatic Aberration** | Shifts the RGB channels apart to fake lens fringing, with pixel amount and direction per channel. |
| **LC Color Match 🎨** | Matches an image's colors to a reference (AdaIN / mean-std) with optional skin protection and mask. |
| **🎨LC Color Palette** | Picks a 4 to 6 color palette from a preset or from an image, for use in prompts. |
| **LC Combo Selector** | A dropdown that mirrors the options of another node's combo (sampler, scheduler, etc.) when wired into it. |
| **LC Control Panel 🎛️** | Up to 16 sliders and on/off switches on one node, each on its own output. The gear on a row sets its type (number or boolean), name, range, step and INT or FLOAT. A new row plugged into a number or boolean input copies that input's settings. |
| **LC Custom Combo** | Builds your own list of options and outputs the chosen text and its index. |
| **LC Custom Combo Panel** | A remote control that picks the choice for an LC Custom Combo from another spot. |
| **LC Denoise 💉** | Injects latent noise scaled to 1 minus your denoise value, using the same denoise you give the sampler. |
| **LC Depth FX 🌫️** | Uses a depth map for atmospheric haze, light wrap and depth of field with real bokeh, with shared looks. |
| **LC Detail Daemon (BETA)** | Adds fine detail by hiding a little of the noise from the model over a window of the steps, on the original Detail Daemon schedule. Look only (default), classic and keep structure modes. Sampler version. Goes on the low pass sampler. |
| **LC Detail Daemon (model) (BETA)** | The same Detail Daemon as a model patch, for a plain KSampler. |
| **LC Detail Pipe Out** | Unpacks the detailer settings (models, prompts, seed, cfg, sampler, scheduler, steps) from an LC_PIPE. protect_mask (bottom): the areas the pipe detailers redrew. |
| **LC Dimension Resize 📐** | Adds, subtracts, multiplies or divides width and height by one value and rounds the results to integers. |
| **LC Directional Blur** | Motion blur along one angle and length, set by dragging an arrow on the node. |
| **LC Dynamic Overlay** | Overlays image B on image A and lets you adjust the opacity on the node after one run without regenerating. |
| **LC Easy Folder 📂** | Builds a filename_prefix for the native Save Image node and creates the folders. |
| **LC Film Grain** | Adds film grain with amount, contrast, size and mono or color options. |
| **LC Film Grain (Video) 🎞️** | The same grain for a whole clip: GPU, a few frames at a time, with a progress bar. Grain sized to the video, so it survives compression. |
| **LC Film Stock (B&W)** | Gives a black and white film look from presets with a strength blend. |
| **LC Film Stock (Color)** | Gives a color film look from presets (toe, shoulder, gamma) with a strength blend. |
| **LC Float Compare** | Outputs the larger or smaller of two floats. |
| **LC Get Image 📐** | Reads an image's width, height, megapixels, longer side, batch size and aspect ratio. |
| **LC Groups Bypasser** | Bypasses whole groups from one place, with one toggle per group. |
| **LC Image Adjust** | Basic color grade (hue, saturation, brightness, contrast) with a mild sharpen or soften. |
| **LC Image Batch From Folder 📂** | Loads a whole folder as one batch in alphabetical order, with max_images and start_index. |
| **LC Image Compare 🔎** | Compares large batches of images with a compact dropdown and a stable image area. |
| **LC Image Crop 🖼️🔪** | Crops by dragging a box and handles on the node, with an optional aspect lock. |
| **LC Image Denoise** | Smart denoise with blur strength, edge preservation and a blend. |
| **LC Image Desaturate** | Desaturates toward grayscale with a factor and a luminance method. |
| **LC Image Grid 🖼️** | Arranges a batch of images into a grid with optional gap, outline and border. |
| **LC Image Label** | A floating image sticker with drag-and-drop upload for annotating a workflow (no sockets). |
| **LC Image Pass** | Passes an image straight through, and its enable switch mutes what hangs off it downstream. |
| **LC Image Ref Pipe In 🖼️** | Bundles up to 16 reference images into one pipe, with sockets that grow like Text Encode Qwen Image 2.1. |
| **LC Image Ref Pipe Out 🖼️** | Unpacks an image ref pipe back into image_1 to image_16 in their original slots, pipe first. |
| **LC Image RGB** | Offsets each color channel separately with an overall strength. |
| **LC Image Split 🖼️** | A before/after wipe on the node whose output is the baked split for saving. |
| **LC Image Stitch Multi 🖼️🪡** | Stitches images side by side or stacked from autogrow slots, with match size, align and an optional gap. |
| **LC Image to Total Megapixels 📐** | Scales an image to a total megapixel count and outputs the resulting resolution. |
| **LC Image-Mask Resize 📐** | Resizes an image and/or mask to a preset, custom size, multiplier or megapixel count, in multiples of divisible_by. |
| **LC Int Compare** | Outputs the larger or smaller of two integers. |
| **LC Int Split** | Splits a total into a + b at a fractional split point, so a + b always equals the total. |
| **LC Invert Boolean** | Coerces a boolean, int or float and outputs the opposite. |
| **LC Is Bypassed / Muted** | Outputs true if the node wired into it is bypassed or muted, read live without queuing. |
| **LC Join Strings 🔗** | Joins multiple strings with a delimiter and skips the empty ones. |
| **LC Krea2 Regional Inline Canvas** | Paint RGB regions on the node and get regional conditioning using the krea2 CLIP type. |
| **LC Label 🏷️** | A floating text label for annotating a workflow, with fonts, color, outline and shadow (no sockets). |
| **LC Last Image Holder** | Keeps the last generated image for before/after comparison, even after disconnecting. Hold until seed change keeps the first image of a seed to compare tweaks against. |
| **LC Lens FX (deprecated)** | Hidden from search. Old workflows still run it. Use Lens Profile, Vignette and Film Grain instead. |
| **LC Lens Profile** | Applies or corrects a named lens profile with adjustable strength. |
| **LC Lift Gamma Gain** | Grades shadows, midtones and highlights with lift, gamma, gain and offset. |
| **🗒️LC Lighting** | Sets lighting style and direction for a prompt from presets plus your own notes. |
| **LC Lighting Control 🔦 (deprecated)** | Old workflows still run it. Use LC Lighting Control V2 instead. |
| **LC Lighting Control V2 🔦** | Relights an image with one or two spot or sun lights, warmth, color gels and hard or soft cast shadows. |
| **LC LoRA Loader 🎚️** | Applies any number of LoRAs from one node, with enable, strength and drag-to-reorder per row. |
| **LC LoRA Loader Stack 🎚️** | Builds the same LoRA list as LC LoRA Loader, output as a LORA_STACK. |
| **LC Mask Pass** | Passes a mask through, and turning it off makes downstream nodes run with no mask (full frame). |
| **LC MiniMax H3 Pipe** | Packs or edits an H3 pipe holding the prompts, references and settings for MiniMax H3. |
| **LC MiniMax H3 Pipe Out** | Unpacks an LC MiniMax H3 pipe into its separate sockets. |
| **LC MiniMax H3 Pipe Out V2** | Unpacks an H3 pipe V2, adding prompt, steps, cfg, seed, sampler and scheduler outputs. |
| **LC MiniMax H3 Pipe V2** | Packs or edits an H3 pipe V2, which also carries prompt, steps, cfg, seed, sampler and scheduler. |
| **LC Model Info ℹ️** | Wire any MODEL in: it follows the wire upstream (LoRA loaders, merges, LC Model Optimizer) and reads each file's header only. Shows the workflow a save node baked in (base models, LoRAs with strengths, merges), Kohya training info and trigger tags, card fields, GGUF type. Live on the node, no queue needed. The model passes through. |
| **LC Model Optimizer ⚡** | Loads the model, text encoder and VAE that suit your card, with the speed-ups that work on it. Downloads recommended files on the first run. Covers Krea 2 (Turbo and Raw), SDXL, Illustrious, Pony and more, plus Custom for any other model. |
| **LC Model Optimizer (pipe) ⚡** | The same as LC Model Optimizer, plus an LC_PIPE out (model 2 carries Ideogram 4's second model). |
| **LC Model Optimizer Video ⚡** | The video version: model, text encoder, video and audio VAE and latent upscaler for MiniMax H3 and LTX 2.5 / 2.3. |
| **LC Model Optimizer Video (pipe) ⚡** | The same as LC Model Optimizer Video, plus an LC_PIPE out (vae 2 carries the audio VAE). |
| **LC Mute** | Works like LC Bypasser, but Off mutes the linked nodes instead of bypassing them. |
| **LC Natural Look 🍃** | Takes the AI look out: pulls back only the loudest colours, calms orange and plastic skin, rolls the highlights off, cuts the glossy glow and lifts fine texture, with your black point, contrast and brightness kept and a whisper of grain. |
| **LC Negative** | A negative prompt text box. |
| **LC Node Snapshot 📋** | Reads another node's widgets and outputs the selected value, all lines, or JSON. |
| **LC Note 📝** | A markdown note that translates into ComfyUI's 14 languages on click through LC Vision, and shows @[card](link) lines as link cards. |
| **LC Notify 🔊** | Plays a chosen sound when the node runs (always, on empty queue, or never). |
| **LC Phone Filters 📱** | 37 phone-app filter presets (1977, Aden, Brooklyn, etc.) with strength and an on-node wipe. |
| **LC Photo Style 📷** | Gives an image a phone-camera look from a style preset, with sliders and a strength blend. |
| **LC Pipe (in/edit)** | Packs values into an LC_PIPE, or merges overrides into an existing pipe. |
| **LC Pipe Combine** | Edits the top pipe with a second pipe: whatever the edit pipe carries overwrites the top one, everything else rides along. |
| **LC Pipe Out** | Expands an LC_PIPE into individual sockets and passes the pipe on. protect_mask (bottom): the areas the pipe detailers redrew. |
| **LC Preview Image 🖼️** | Previews an image and sits quietly instead of erroring when nothing arrives. |
| **LC Preview Mask 🎭** | Previews a mask and sits quietly instead of erroring when nothing arrives. |
| **🧩LC Prompt Assembler** | Assembles the prompt builder pieces (subject, camera, lighting, style, scene) into one prompt or JSON. |
| **LC Prompt to Conditioning + Zero** | Encodes a prompt into conditioning and also outputs a zeroed copy for the negative. |
| **LC Reference Latent** | Attaches up to eight reference latents to conditioning. |
| **LC RTX Super Resolution ⚡** | NVIDIA RTX Video Super Resolution on pictures or video frames: upscale up to 4x, upscale a clean source, denoise or deblur. Quality LOW to ULTRA, scale or megapixels, strength. Shows an Install RTX support button when nvidia-vfx is missing. |
| **LC Sampler Configure** | Central dual-pass sampler settings: steps, swap point, detailer steps, denoise, CFGs, sampler and scheduler. |
| **LC Sampler Configure (pipe)** | Dual-pass sampler settings with an optional pipe in and a pipe out. |
| **LC Sampler Configure Pipe Out** | Unpacks an LC_PIPE into the sampler configure sockets, plus the latent. |
| **LC Sampler Configure Simple** | Single-pass sampler settings with one CFG and no step swap. |
| **LC Sampler Configure Simple (pipe)** | Simple sampler settings that read from and write to an LC_PIPE. |
| **LC Sampler Scheduler ⚙️** | Pick the sampler and scheduler once and wire them to every KSampler, so they all change together. |
| **LC Save Image 💾** | Saves images with workflow metadata, and CivitAI parameters when paired with LC Save Metadata. |
| **LC Save Metadata 🏷️** | Builds the metadata (models, AIR or URL, settings) that LC Save Image writes. |
| **📝 LC Save Text** | Writes a text string to a file in the output folder. |
| **🗒️LC Scene Builder** | Builds a scene description from scene presets and objects. |
| **🌱LC Seed** | A utility seed with a mode that also works when you queue only this node. |
| **LC Seed Jump 🌱** | Takes a seed and a jump value and outputs the seed plus five successive jumps. |
| **LC Sharpen Pro** | Undoes softness (deconvolution) with texture and clarity, halo control and skin protection. Presets for photos, line art, anime and illustration. |
| **LC Show Any 🔤** | Shows any value on the node and passes it through with its type unchanged. |
| **LC Show Text 🔤** | Shows a string on the node and passes it on. |
| **LC Sigma Curve** | Draw a custom sigma curve on the node, save it, and reuse it. |
| **LC Sigma Resample** | Resamples a sigma curve to a new step count while keeping its start and end sigma (also registered as LCChangeStepCount). |
| **LC Sigmas (BETA)** | One scheduler for one- and two-pass sampling: sigma curve presets (base, beta, flowmatch, hyperbolic, gaussian, your saved curves) you can bend by dragging the graph, step swap, denoise, continue or renoise on the second pass, and sigma shift. Takes regular and RES4LYF / ClownShark sampler names. |
| **LC Size Pad 📐** | A 2D slider for width x height: drag the frame's corner. Model presets (MiniMax H3, Krea 2, SDXL, LTX, Klein 9B, Wan 2.2) snap to the model's step and stop at its megapixel limit; aspect lock and portrait / landscape flip. |
| **LC Skin Beauty ✨** | Cools, brightens and evens skin in LAB with presets, protecting highlights, with an optional mask. Runs on GPU or CPU. |
| **LC Skin Texture ✨ (BETA)** | Adds real pore texture to skin that came out too smooth, from a real skin photo (only its fine relief, never its colour). Optional protect_mask leaves the detailers' areas alone. |
| **LC Skin Upscale** | Upscales only the masked skin area with a CNN model and blends it back. Optional protect_mask leaves the detailers' areas alone. |
| **LC Slider** | A slider on the node face that outputs an int or float. |
| **LC Speed Boost (BETA) 🚀** | About 2x faster sampling (about 1.4x on SDXL / Pony / Illustrious), same quality: the picture starts at half size and grows to full size partway through. Plug it into the high pass sampler. |
| **LC Speed Boost 🚀 KSampler (BETA)** | A KSampler with Speed Boost built in. Same inputs, plus start / end at step so it can chain into another sampler. Takes ClownShark (RES4LYF) samplers. |
| **LC Split Sigma Scheduler** | Splits sigmas between two models for a dual-model SamplerCustomAdvanced. |
| **LC Split Sigmas (Advanced)** | Splits sigma curves at a swap step into a high and a low set. |
| **LC Stop 🛑** | A queue breakpoint you can enable to pause until you continue. |
| **🗒️LC Style Selector** | Picks a style preset (and quality level) for a prompt and adds your own notes. |
| **🗒️LC Subject** | Describes the subject of a prompt with freeform text plus pose, action, outfit and placement options. |
| **🗒️LC Subject Array** | Combines several subject outputs into one line. |
| **LC Text Overlay** | Draws text on an image with a draggable position, font size and color. |
| **LC Text Remove 🔪** | Removes up to twenty substrings from a text, in order. |
| **LC ✂️ Duplicate Tags 🏷️** | Removes repeated tags so none gets double weight (long_hair = (long hair:1.2)). Optional second prompt to merge two and clean them together. |
| **LC 🚦** | A light for a boolean: one color for true, one for false (or none). Colors behind the gear. |
| **LC Text Replace ✂️** | Runs up to twenty find and replace pairs (optionally regex) on a text. |
| **LC Timer ⏱️** | Times every run and scores the newest one against the 5 before it: faster in green, slower in red. Lists the last 10 runs. Stopped and fully cached runs are left out. |
| **LC Tone Match** | Keeps the reference's broad lighting and color while keeping the image's fine detail, with an optional mask. |
| **LC Vibrance** | Smart saturation (vibrance) with optional plain saturation and skin protection. |
| **LC Vignette** | Darkens or brightens the edges of the image. |
| **LC VRAM Cache Clear** | A pass-through node that clears GPU and model cache when it runs, also on its own branch with nothing after it. |
| **LC Watermark 💧** | Composites a watermark image you position by dragging, with live size and opacity. Transparent PNGs keep their transparency through watermark_mask. |
| **LC Widget To String** | Reads a widget on another node as a string. |
| **🎲LC Wildcard** | Picks a random line from a wildcard text file. |
| **Prompt** | A prompt text box (was LC Positive). The Vision Assistant swaps it in for other packs' text boxes, or LC Negative when the box feeds a negative. |
| **Prompt to Conditioning** | Encodes a text prompt into CLIP conditioning. |

## LC AV v0.3.13

[github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_AV_nodes](https://github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_AV_nodes)

| Node | What it does |
|---|---|
| **LC Audio Channel 🎚️** | Splits stereo audio into left and right, and duplicates mono to both. |
| **LC Audio Crop ✂️** | Crops audio from a start time to an end time (MM:SS). |
| **LC Audio Duration ⏱️** | Outputs the audio length as seconds and minutes, as int and float. |
| **LC Audio EQ 3-Band 🎛️** | A 3-band equalizer with a low shelf, a peaking mid and a high shelf. |
| **LC Audio Separate 🎼** | Splits audio into Bass, Drums, Other and Vocals stems with Hybrid Demucs. |
| **LC Audio Volume 🔊** | Changes audio volume with a slider and soft-clips after the gain. |

| **LC AV Pipe Out 🎬** | Unpacks an LC_AV_PIPE into its slots and passes the av_pipe on. |
| **LC Create Video 🎬** | Builds an LC_AV_PIPE from an image batch (it does not encode a file). |
| **LC Final Frame 🖼️** | Outputs the last frame of an image batch. |
| **LC Get Latent Size 📐** | Reads the pixel width and height of a latent, plus batch and frames for video latents. |
| **LC Load Audio 📂** | Loads audio from the input folder with start and end trim and a preview player. |
| **LC Pipe → AV Pipe 🔌** | Converts an LC_PIPE or MiniMax H3 pipe into an LC_AV_PIPE, copying only the shared fields. |

## LC MaskMaker v0.19.8

[github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_MaskMaker_nodes](https://github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_MaskMaker_nodes)

| Node | What it does |
|---|---|
| **LC Auto Adjust 🔆** | One-click auto levels (per channel, luminance, saturation or mono) with trims, a strength blend and an optional mask. |
| **LC Create Mask 🖼️✏️** | Draws a mask right on the node with points or a freehand pencil, with feather, invert and opacity built in. |
| **LC Depth Anything V2 🌊** | Makes a Depth Anything V2 depth map (bright = near) as an image and a mask. Model list reads the same on every machine. |
| **LC Face Crop 📐** | Crops to a format with the faces placed well instead of a blind centre crop, using the Aspect Ratio Simplifier presets. Framing from widest to face only. |
| **LC Image Blend Advance 🎚️** | Places a layer on a background (position, scale, rotate, mirror) and blends it with 29 blend modes through an optional mask. |
| **LC Outpaint, Rotate, & Pad 🔄** | Turn, crop and pad a picture by dragging on the node, with a portrait / landscape flip. The mask covers the padding and the corners a turn opens up. max_megapixels stops the frame at that size. |
| **LC Krea2 AnyPaint 🩹** | Krea 2 inpaint and outpaint with the AnyPaint LoRA. Everything outside the mask comes back exactly as it was, and the seam disappears. |
| **LC Z-Image AnyPaint 🩹** | The same inpaint and outpaint for Z-Image (Turbo / Base), painted by the Z-Image Fun ControlNet Union 2.1 patch instead of a LoRA. Everything outside the mask comes back exactly as it was. |
| **LC SDXL AnyPaint 🩹** | The same inpaint and outpaint for any SDXL checkpoint (SDXL, Pony, Illustrious), painted by ControlNet Union ProMax, Fooocus inpaint optional. No LoRA needed. |
| **LC Mask Refine ✨** | Tightens a mask with a trimap, using a guided filter or VITMatte on the edge band only, with a before/after wipe. |
| **LC Normal Map (BAE) 🗺️** | Makes a BAE surface normal map (RGB = XYZ), the same style ControlNet's normal_bae makes. |
| **LC Outpaint 🖌️➕** | Drag the canvas edges outward on the node to build a grey canvas and a mask of the new area. max_megapixels stops the edges at that size. |
| **LC Person Mask 🧍** | Selects parts of a person (face, hair, body, clothes, accessories, background) with Segformer or MediaPipe. remove_features makes a skin-only mask. |
| **LC Remove Background ✂️** | Removes the background with BiRefNet and outputs an RGBA cutout, the mask and the subject on a solid color. |
| **LC Segment Anything 🎯** | Selects things by describing them, using GroundingDINO + SAM or SAM 3, with optional edge refine. |
| **LC Smart Detailer 🩹** | Replaces the SEGS / Impact detailers. Finds what you type (hands, face, eyes) with SAM 3 and redraws each one in its own upscaled crop, then blends it back in. |
| **LC Smart Detailer (pipe) 🩹** | The same, with model, VAE and sampler settings from the LC pipe. A wired model or VAE overrides the pipe's. |
| **LC VOSR2 Upscale 🧩** | Fast, low-VRAM upscale with VOSR 2.0, built in: sharpens and adds fine detail without redrawing the picture. 1.5x to 4x in one pass, 6x and 8x in two. |
| **LC VOSR2 Upscale (pipe) 🧩** | The same on the LC pipe, after the pipe detailers. Carries the detailers' areas to the new size (protected output) for LC Skin Upscale / LC Skin Texture. |

## LC Vision v1.5.1

[github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_Vision_nodes](https://github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_Vision_nodes)

| Node | What it does |
|---|---|
| **LC Vision Director (BETA) 🎬** | Plans a long MiniMax H3 video as a chain of CUT / CONTINUE segments with one shared style block, made one per Run by the LC H3 Segment nodes. Saves the plan and reuses it. |
| **LC Vision Reviewer 🕵️ (BETA)** | Quality gate: yes/no checks on hands, faces, text, artifacts, prompt match and your own questions. Flags a bad render, or blocks everything after it. |
| **LC Vision Shot List (BETA) 📋** | The story for the Director, filled in like a form: the place, the cast and one row per shot. Suggests the segment count and warns about lines too long for their shot. No AI involved. |

| **LC VAE Compare** | Decodes the same latents with up to six VAEs, side by side with a 1:1 detail crop, a sharpness number and how far each lands from the first. |
| **LC VAE Merge** | Merges the decoders of two VAEs of the same family, coarse shapes to fine texture. The encoder stays the base's, so the result still fits the models made for it. |
| **LC VAE Save** | Saves a VAE to models/vae in fp32, bf16 or fp16. |

---
"True Nothing is. Permitted Everything is"- Yoda Auditore, Assassin's Wars

en.text:
# LC Settings ⚙️

**Where are they?** Open **Settings** (the gear), then **LC Settings ⚙️**. There are five sections: **Align**, **Connections**, **Notes**, **Optimization** and **Performance**, plus **Vision** when **LC Vision** is installed.

- 💡 Missing a setting? Restart ComfyUI, then press **Ctrl+F5** so the browser loads the new files.

---

### 📐 Align

**Align tool**
- Default: **On**
- The switch for the whole tool. Off = no **Align** button (the LC logo) in the top toolbar and none of the features below.
- With it on, the **Align** button turns Align on or off **for the open workflow**: light gray with the red flame = on, dark gray with a gray flame = off.
    - That on/off is saved in the workflow. Save it with Align on and it opens with Align on, even on a fresh ComfyUI.
    - Every workflow tab keeps its own. Switch tabs and the tool follows that tab (on in one, off in the other, no mix-ups).
    - Turning it on or off counts as a change to the workflow, so you get the unsaved dot.
- Nodes snap to **Node lines**, groups snap to **Group lines**. A line lights up when you get close.
- Works on the classic canvas and in **Nodes 2.0**.
- **Snap distance** is ComfyUI's own **Snap to grid size** (Settings > Lite Graph > Canvas). Smaller grid = tighter snap. New lines land on that grid too.
    - **Shift** while dragging hands the drag to ComfyUI's own grid snap (no line snap). With **Always snap to grid** on, a line snap still wins on the axis it caught.

**Rulers**
- Default: **On**
- Rulers on the top and left edge while Align is on:
    - **Left click** a ruler: adds a **Node line** (blue). Nodes snap to it.
    - **Right click** a ruler: adds a **Group line** (orange). Groups snap to it.
    - **LC Notes** snap to both, since a note can label a node or a group.
    - Click a line's marker again to remove it. Drag a marker to move it.
- Lines save with the workflow.

**Line reveal distance (px)**
- Default: **120**
- Lines stay invisible until the cursor or whatever you drag gets this close.

**Also snap to other nodes and groups**
- Default: **Off**
- On = also snap to other nodes' edges and centers (no line is shown for those).

---

### 🔌 Connections

**Connection FX**
- Default: **Off**
- While you drag a wire, every socket it can plug into glows in its socket color.
- Get close and rings pulse out of the socket. Closer = bigger and brighter.
- **Connection FX reach (px):** how close the cursor has to be before the rings start. Default 160.
- **Connection FX zoomed-out glow (%):** zoomed out, every valid socket glows brighter so you can find it. Default 60.
- Classic canvas only. With **Nodes 2.0** on it stays out of the way.

---

### 🔬 Vision

- Only there when **LC Vision** is installed.

**Vision Assistant**
- Default: **On**
- The sidebar helper: checkup, chat, guided tours and snapshots. Off removes the tab.

**Batch snapshot**
- Default: **On**
- A look at the run before it starts. A single image always goes straight through.
- Run only stops to ask when it looks like a mistake: more than 16 images, several runs on a fixed seed, a big upscale on many images.

**Vision Assistant chat model**
- Default: **Auto** (leave it here). It picks the biggest model that fits your card and only loads it while you chat.
- It unloads a minute after the last answer, or the moment you hit Run.
- **Off** = no chat model at all. The checkup, snapshots and saved tours still work, with no VRAM.

**Default n_ctx for new LC Vision Loaders**
- Default: **8192**, the best pick for most people. Smaller saves memory. Saved workflows keep their own value.

**Vision models**
- What's on your drive, and a **Download** button for the models made for LC Vision.

---

### 📝 Notes

**Requires LC Vision for translation**
- Shows whether **LC Vision** is installed. Translating notes needs it.

**Note language**
- LC notes will open in the default language set for Comfy if they have already been translated to that

**Translate all notes**
- One click translates every **LC Note** in the open workflow (subgraphs too) into your **Note language**, one after another, then shows them in it.
- Notes already written in that language, or with an up-to-date translation, are skipped. Out-of-date translations (⚠️) are redone.
- Only LC Notes are touched. Other notes are left alone.
- Needs **LC Vision** installed (nothing to wire).
- ⚠️ Save the workflow afterwards to keep the translations.

**Link cards**
- Default: **On**
- A line with just `@[card](https://…)` in an LC Note shows the page as a card: picture, site, title and description. `@[card: caption](https://…)` adds your own caption.
- Put each card on a line of its own, with a blank line before and after it. Without the blank lines they stay plain links.
- Double-click the note to edit: the cards step aside so you can change the `@[card](…)` text. They come back when you click away.
- Wide pictures (banners) get a wider slot so they show whole.
- ComfyUI reads each card's page once, and the picture loads from that site. Only public web addresses, never your own machine or network. Off = cards show as plain links.

---

### 🩺 Optimization

**Fast cancel**
- Default: **On**
- Cancel stops a run in a fraction of a second instead of finishing the step first (heavy models, USDU, video).
- Works with every sampler, nothing to wire.

**Free text encoder before sampling**
- Default: **On**
- When sampling starts, any big text encoder (1 GB or more) still in VRAM moves to RAM, so the model gets the whole card.
- Biggest win on H3 and Krea 2. A new prompt reloads it from RAM in a second or two.

**Comfy Optimization Report**
- One button. It pans the canvas by itself for a few seconds, times what every pack in the open workflow draws and runs, and scans their files.
- You get a list of what slows your canvas down, biggest first, sorted into:
    - **That pack's own settings** (the exact setting name, where it lives and its current value)
    - **LC123 optimization settings**
    - **ComfyUI settings**
    - **Sidebar tabs**
    - **Required to function** (no setting, it is how that pack works)
- Only node packs used in the open workflow are analyzed.
- Every setting it suggests is checked against its current value:
    - ⚠️ big gain · ✅ worthwhile gain · 💡 small gain
    - ⚪ already set · ➖ does not apply · ℹ️ required, no setting for it
- **Show last run:** the button at the top flips to the previous report. Each new run also shows what got faster and which fixes are done since last time.
    - Only the last run is kept (it survives a refresh). Each run replaces it.
- Nothing is changed. (Keep the mouse still while it runs.)
- 💡 Also in the right-click menu on the empty canvas.

**System & Model Optimization Report**
- One button. It tests this machine in about 10 seconds: graphics card, VRAM, RAM, page file, drive speed, and which speed-ups really work here (Sage, Triton, Sol-Attn, Comfy Kitchen, fp8 / int8 / nvfp4, llama-cpp).
- ⚠️ problem · 💡 worth changing · ✅ works · ℹ️ info · ➖ not installed
- Then it tells you which model files suit this machine:
    - **Recommended to install:** links to Sage, Triton, Comfy Kitchen etc. for this card when they're missing (links only, nothing is installed)
    - **LC Vision model suggestion** (Quality / Optimal / Fast, with the context size to set)
    - **When picking a model (includes custom models):** what to get for Quality, Optimal and Fast, a size guide, and what to avoid
    - **Model recommendations:** exact files with download links for the tested base models, plus **All base models at a glance**
- **Show last run** and **Copy report** work like the Comfy Optimization Report. It will not run while ComfyUI is generating.
- Nothing is changed. (Also in the right-click menu on the empty canvas.)
- 💡 The **LC Model Optimizer** nodes read this report: run it once and they load the right files and speed-ups for this machine. (With LC Vision installed, its Loader also puts a ★ on the model that suits your card.)

**Node Pack Usage Report**
- One button: **Scan my workflows folder**. It reads every saved workflow (subgraphs too) and shows which installed packs they actually use.
- Lists the packs no workflow uses, the ones only one or two use, and nodes your workflows need that no installed pack has.
- Nothing is changed or uninstalled.

---

### ⚡ Performance

These only change what you see on the canvas. Generation, VRAM, **Save Image** and every **IMAGE** output stay full resolution. (A lighter preview never means a lighter image.)

| Setting | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| **Remove wipe** | Off | Turns off the hover A/B wipe on LC image FX nodes. The last result still shows. |
| **Half-resolution previews** | Off | Draws FX previews at half size. Less work while panning. |
| **Clamp longest side** | Off | Shrinks on-node previews so the longest side fits **Max edge**. |
| **Max edge (px)** | 768 | Only used when **Clamp longest side** is on. Range 256 to 2048. Try 512 on heavy graphs. |
| **No preview when collapsed** | On | Collapsed FX nodes skip drawing their preview. |
| **Hide FX on-node previews** | Off | Hides every LC image FX preview. |
| **Recent colors** | On | Keeps your last 8 custom colors in the right-click **Colors** menu. Adds a Custom picker if Custom Scripts is not installed. |
| **Skin Beauty full preview override** | On | **LC Skin Beauty** keeps a full-quality preview even with half-res or clamp on, so you can still zoom into skin. Wipe still follows **Remove wipe**. |
| **LoRA loader info button** | On | Shows the ℹ button on each **LC LoRA Loader** row. Trigger words come from the LoRA file itself (no internet). Turn off to declutter. |
| **Preview distance (px)** | 40 | Like node text, an on-node image switches off when you zoom out far enough that it is drawn smaller than this. Smaller previews switch off first. 0 = always draw. |

**Never affected:** **LC Image Compare 🔎**, **LC Image Split 🖼️** and **LC Dynamic Overlay** keep their full preview and wipe no matter what (only **Preview distance** switches them off when zoomed far out).

**Suggested setups**
- **Normal use:** leave everything at default.
- **Laggy graph:** turn on **Half-resolution previews** and **Clamp longest side** (Max edge 512). Keep **No preview when collapsed** on.
- **Lightest canvas:** turn on **Hide FX on-node previews**. Use **Image Compare** or **Image Split** when you need to see a before/after.
- 💡 Changes apply on the next redraw. Pan the canvas a little, no restart needed.

---

"True Nothing is. Permitted Everything is"- Yoda Auditore, Assassin's Wars

zh.text:
# LC 设置 ⚙️

**在哪里？** 打开 **Settings**（齿轮），然后进入 **LC Settings ⚙️**。一共有五个部分：**Align**、**Connections**、**Notes**、**Optimization** 和 **Performance**，安装了 **LC Vision** 时还有 **Vision**。

- 💡 找不到某个设置？重启 ComfyUI，然后按 **Ctrl+F5**，让浏览器加载新文件。

---

### 📐 Align

**Align tool**
- 默认：**开**
- 整个工具的总开关。关 = 顶部工具栏里没有 **Align** 按钮（LC 标志），下面的功能也都没有。
- 开启后，**Align** 按钮可以**针对当前打开的工作流**开关 Align：浅灰色带红色火焰 = 开，深灰色带灰色火焰 = 关。
    - 这个开/关状态会保存在工作流里。开着 Align 保存，下次打开就是开着的，即使是全新的 ComfyUI。
    - 每个工作流标签页各自保存。切换标签页，工具会跟随那个标签页（一个开一个关，不会混淆）。
    - 开关它算作对工作流的修改，所以会出现未保存的圆点。
- 节点吸附到 **Node lines**，分组吸附到 **Group lines**。靠近时线会亮起来。
- 在经典画布和 **Nodes 2.0** 中都能用。
- **Snap distance** 就是 ComfyUI 自己的 **Snap to grid size**（Settings > Lite Graph > Canvas）。网格越小，吸附越紧。新的线也会落在这个网格上。
    - 拖动时按住 **Shift**，会把拖动交给 ComfyUI 自己的网格吸附（不做线吸附）。开启 **Always snap to grid** 时，线吸附仍然会在它捕获的那个轴上优先生效。

**Rulers**
- 默认：**开**
- Align 开启时，顶部和左侧边缘会出现标尺：
    - **左键点击**标尺：添加一条 **Node line**（蓝色）。节点会吸附到它。
    - **右键点击**标尺：添加一条 **Group line**（橙色）。分组会吸附到它。
    - **LC Notes** 两种都吸附，因为一个笔记可以标注节点，也可以标注分组。
    - 再次点击线的标记可以删除。拖动标记可以移动。
- 线会随工作流一起保存。

**Line reveal distance (px)**
- 默认：**120**
- 线一直是隐形的，直到光标或你拖动的东西靠近到这个距离。

**Also snap to other nodes and groups**
- 默认：**关**
- 开 = 同时吸附到其他节点的边缘和中心（这些不会显示线）。

---

### 🔌 Connections

**Connection FX**
- 默认：**关**
- 拖动连线时，所有可以接入的接口都会以各自接口的颜色发光。
- 靠近时，接口会向外扩散光圈。越近 = 越大越亮。
- **Connection FX reach (px)：** 光标要多近，光圈才开始出现。默认 160。
- **Connection FX zoomed-out glow (%)：** 缩小视图时，每个有效接口会发出更亮的光，方便你找到它。默认 60。
- 仅限经典画布。开启 **Nodes 2.0** 时，它会自动让开。

---

### 🔬 Vision

- 只有安装了 **LC Vision** 才会出现。

**Vision Assistant**
- 默认：**开**
- 侧边栏助手：检查、聊天、引导教程和快照。关闭会移除这个标签页。

**Batch snapshot**
- 默认：**开**
- 在运行开始前先看一眼。单张图像始终直接通过。
- 只有看起来像是失误时才会停下来询问：超过 16 张图、固定 seed 下多次运行、对很多图做大幅放大。

**Vision Assistant chat model**
- 默认：**Auto**（保持这个就行）。它会选出你显卡能装下的最大模型，并且只在你聊天时才加载。
- 最后一次回答一分钟后，或者你一点 Run 的瞬间，它就会卸载。
- **Off** = 完全没有聊天模型。检查、快照和已保存的教程仍然可用，且不占显存。

**Default n_ctx for new LC Vision Loaders**
- 默认：**8192**，对大多数人来说是最佳选择。更小可以省内存。已保存的工作流会保留它们自己的值。

**Vision models**
- 显示你硬盘上有什么，以及一个 **Download** 按钮，用来下载为 LC Vision 准备的模型。

---

### 📝 Notes

**Requires LC Vision for translation**
- 显示是否已安装 **LC Vision**。翻译笔记需要它。

**Note language**
- 如果 LC notes 已经被翻译成 Comfy 默认设置的语言，就会以该语言打开

**Translate all notes**
- 一次点击，就会依次把当前工作流（包括子图）里每一个 **LC Note** 翻译成你的 **Note language**，然后以该语言显示。
- 已经是该语言写的笔记，或翻译是最新的笔记会被跳过。过期的翻译（⚠️）会重做。
- 只处理 LC Notes。其他笔记不动。
- 需要安装 **LC Vision**（不用连线）。
- ⚠️ 之后记得保存工作流，才能保留翻译。

**Link cards**
- 默认：**开**
- LC Note 中只有 `@[card](https://…)` 的一行，会把该页面显示为卡片：图片、网站、标题和描述。`@[card: caption](https://…)` 可以加上你自己的说明文字。
- 每张卡片单独占一行，前后各留一个空行。没有空行的话，它们只是普通链接。
- 双击笔记进行编辑：卡片会让开，这样你就能修改 `@[card](…)` 文本。点击别处后它们又会回来。
- 宽图（横幅）会得到更宽的位置，以便完整显示。
- ComfyUI 对每张卡片的页面只读取一次，图片从该网站加载。只支持公开的网址，绝不包括你自己的机器或网络。关 = 卡片显示为普通链接。

---

### 🩺 Optimization

**Fast cancel**
- 默认：**开**
- 取消会在不到一秒内停止运行，而不是先把当前这一步跑完（重型模型、USDU、视频）。
- 对所有采样器都有效，不用连线。

**Free text encoder before sampling**
- 默认：**开**
- 采样开始时，仍留在显存里的任何大型文本编码器（1 GB 或以上）都会移到内存里，这样模型就能独占整张显卡。
- 对 H3 和 Krea 2 收益最大。新的提示词会在一两秒内从内存重新加载它。

**Comfy Optimization Report**
- 一个按钮。它会自己平移画布几秒钟，测量当前工作流中每个插件包的绘制和运行耗时，并扫描它们的文件。
- 你会得到一份拖慢画布的清单，最严重的排在前面，分为：
    - **该插件包自己的设置**（确切的设置名称、它在哪里、当前值）
    - **LC123 优化设置**
    - **ComfyUI 设置**
    - **侧边栏标签页**
    - **功能所必需**（没有设置，它本来就是这样工作的）
- 只分析当前工作流中用到的节点包。
- 它建议的每一个设置都会对照当前值检查：
    - ⚠️ 收益大 · ✅ 值得的收益 · 💡 收益小
    - ⚪ 已设置 · ➖ 不适用 · ℹ️ 必需，没有对应设置
- **Show last run：** 顶部的按钮会切换到上一份报告。每次新的运行还会显示相比上次变快了什么、哪些修复已经完成。
    - 只保留最近一次（刷新后依然保留）。每次运行都会替换它。
- 不会更改任何东西。（运行期间请保持鼠标不动。）
- 💡 在空白画布上右键菜单里也有。

**System & Model Optimization Report**
- 一个按钮。大约 10 秒钟测试这台机器：显卡、显存、内存、页面文件、硬盘速度，以及哪些加速项在这里真正有效（Sage、Triton、Sol-Attn、Comfy Kitchen、fp8 / int8 / nvfp4、llama-cpp）。
- ⚠️ 问题 · 💡 值得改 · ✅ 可用 · ℹ️ 信息 · ➖ 未安装
- 然后它会告诉你哪些模型文件适合这台机器：
    - **Recommended to install：** 如果缺少，会给出适合这块显卡的 Sage、Triton、Comfy Kitchen 等的链接（只有链接，不会安装任何东西）
    - **LC Vision model suggestion**（Quality / Optimal / Fast，以及要设置的 context size）
    - **When picking a model（包括自定义模型）：** Quality、Optimal 和 Fast 各应该选什么、大小指南，以及要避免什么
    - **Model recommendations：** 测试过的基础模型的确切文件和下载链接，外加 **All base models at a glance**
- **Show last run** 和 **Copy report** 的用法和 Comfy Optimization Report 一样。ComfyUI 正在生成时它不会运行。
- 不会更改任何东西。（空白画布上右键菜单里也有。）
- 💡 **LC Model Optimizer** 节点会读取这份报告：运行一次，它们就会为这台机器加载合适的文件和加速项。（如果安装了 LC Vision，它的 Loader 还会在适合你显卡的模型上打一个 ★。）

**Node Pack Usage Report**
- 一个按钮：**Scan my workflows folder**。它会读取每个已保存的工作流（包括子图），并显示它们实际用到了哪些已安装的插件包。
- 列出没有任何工作流用到的插件包、只有一两个工作流用到的插件包，以及你的工作流需要但没有任何已安装插件包提供的节点。
- 不会更改或卸载任何东西。

---

### ⚡ Performance

这些只会改变你在画布上看到的东西。生成、显存、**Save Image** 以及每个 **IMAGE** 输出都保持完整分辨率。（预览变轻不代表图像变轻。）

| 设置 | 默认 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|
| **Remove wipe** | 关 | 关闭 LC 图像 FX 节点上悬停的 A/B 擦除对比。最后一次结果仍然会显示。 |
| **Half-resolution previews** | 关 | 以一半尺寸绘制 FX 预览。平移时负担更小。 |
| **Clamp longest side** | 关 | 缩小节点上的预览，使最长边适应 **Max edge**。 |
| **Max edge (px)** | 768 | 仅在 **Clamp longest side** 开启时使用。范围 256 到 2048。重型工作流可以试试 512。 |
| **No preview when collapsed** | 开 | 折叠的 FX 节点不绘制预览。 |
| **Hide FX on-node previews** | 关 | 隐藏所有 LC 图像 FX 预览。 |
| **Recent colors** | 开 | 在右键 **Colors** 菜单中保留你最近的 8 个自定义颜色。如果没有安装 Custom Scripts，则增加一个 Custom 取色器。 |
| **Skin Beauty full preview override** | 开 | 即使开启了半分辨率或限制，**LC Skin Beauty** 也保持完整质量的预览，这样你仍然可以放大查看皮肤。擦除对比仍然遵循 **Remove wipe**。 |
| **LoRA loader info button** | 开 | 在每个 **LC LoRA Loader** 行上显示 ℹ 按钮。触发词来自 LoRA 文件本身（不需要联网）。关闭可让界面更清爽。 |
| **Preview distance (px)** | 40 | 和节点文字一样，当你缩小到节点上的图像被画得比这个值还小时，它就会关闭。较小的预览先关闭。0 = 始终绘制。 |

**永远不受影响：** **LC Image Compare 🔎**、**LC Image Split 🖼️** 和 **LC Dynamic Overlay** 无论如何都保持完整预览和擦除对比（只有缩得很远时 **Preview distance** 才会把它们关闭）。

**建议配置**
- **正常使用：** 全部保持默认。
- **图卡顿：** 开启 **Half-resolution previews** 和 **Clamp longest side**（Max edge 512）。保持 **No preview when collapsed** 开启。
- **最轻量的画布：** 开启 **Hide FX on-node previews**。需要看前后对比时用 **Image Compare** 或 **Image Split**。
- 💡 更改在下一次重绘时生效。稍微平移一下画布即可，不需要重启。

---

"True Nothing is. Permitted Everything is"- Yoda Auditore, Assassin's Wars

# LC Settings ⚙️

**Where are they?** Open **Settings** (the gear), then **LC Settings ⚙️**. There are five sections: **Align**, **Connections**, **Notes**, **Optimization** and **Performance**, plus **Vision** when **LC Vision** is installed.

- 💡 Missing a setting? Restart ComfyUI, then press **Ctrl+F5** so the browser loads the new files.

---

### 📐 Align

**Align tool**
- Default: **On**
- The switch for the whole tool. Off = no **Align** button (the LC logo) in the top toolbar and none of the features below.
- With it on, the **Align** button turns Align on or off **for the open workflow**: light gray with the red flame = on, dark gray with a gray flame = off.
    - That on/off is saved in the workflow. Save it with Align on and it opens with Align on, even on a fresh ComfyUI.
    - Every workflow tab keeps its own. Switch tabs and the tool follows that tab (on in one, off in the other, no mix-ups).
    - Turning it on or off counts as a change to the workflow, so you get the unsaved dot.
- Nodes snap to **Node lines**, groups snap to **Group lines**. A line lights up when you get close.
- Works on the classic canvas and in **Nodes 2.0**.
- **Snap distance** is ComfyUI's own **Snap to grid size** (Settings > Lite Graph > Canvas). Smaller grid = tighter snap. New lines land on that grid too.
    - **Shift** while dragging hands the drag to ComfyUI's own grid snap (no line snap). With **Always snap to grid** on, a line snap still wins on the axis it caught.

**Rulers**
- Default: **On**
- Rulers on the top and left edge while Align is on:
    - **Left click** a ruler: adds a **Node line** (blue). Nodes snap to it.
    - **Right click** a ruler: adds a **Group line** (orange). Groups snap to it.
    - **LC Notes** snap to both, since a note can label a node or a group.
    - Click a line's marker again to remove it. Drag a marker to move it.
- Lines save with the workflow.

**Line reveal distance (px)**
- Default: **120**
- Lines stay invisible until the cursor or whatever you drag gets this close.

**Also snap to other nodes and groups**
- Default: **Off**
- On = also snap to other nodes' edges and centers (no line is shown for those).

---

### 🔌 Connections

**Connection FX**
- Default: **Off**
- While you drag a wire, every socket it can plug into glows in its socket color.
- Get close and rings pulse out of the socket. Closer = bigger and brighter.
- **Connection FX reach (px):** how close the cursor has to be before the rings start. Default 160.
- **Connection FX zoomed-out glow (%):** zoomed out, every valid socket glows brighter so you can find it. Default 60.
- Classic canvas only. With **Nodes 2.0** on it stays out of the way.

---

### 🔬 Vision

- Only there when **LC Vision** is installed.

**Vision Assistant**
- Default: **On**
- The sidebar helper: checkup, chat, guided tours and snapshots. Off removes the tab.

**Batch snapshot**
- Default: **On**
- A look at the run before it starts. A single image always goes straight through.
- Run only stops to ask when it looks like a mistake: more than 16 images, several runs on a fixed seed, a big upscale on many images.

**Vision Assistant chat model**
- Default: **Auto** (leave it here). It picks the biggest model that fits your card and only loads it while you chat.
- It unloads a minute after the last answer, or the moment you hit Run.
- **Off** = no chat model at all. The checkup, snapshots and saved tours still work, with no VRAM.

**Default n_ctx for new LC Vision Loaders**
- Default: **8192**, the best pick for most people. Smaller saves memory. Saved workflows keep their own value.

**Vision models**
- What's on your drive, and a **Download** button for the models made for LC Vision.

---

### 📝 Notes

**Requires LC Vision for translation**
- Shows whether **LC Vision** is installed. Translating notes needs it.

**Note language**
- LC notes will open in the default language set for Comfy if they have already been translated to that

**Translate all notes**
- One click translates every **LC Note** in the open workflow (subgraphs too) into your **Note language**, one after another, then shows them in it.
- Notes already written in that language, or with an up-to-date translation, are skipped. Out-of-date translations (⚠️) are redone.
- Only LC Notes are touched. Other notes are left alone.
- Needs **LC Vision** installed (nothing to wire).
- ⚠️ Save the workflow afterwards to keep the translations.

**Link cards**
- Default: **On**
- A line with just `@[card](https://…)` in an LC Note shows the page as a card: picture, site, title and description. `@[card: caption](https://…)` adds your own caption.
- Put each card on a line of its own, with a blank line before and after it. Without the blank lines they stay plain links.
- Double-click the note to edit: the cards step aside so you can change the `@[card](…)` text. They come back when you click away.
- Wide pictures (banners) get a wider slot so they show whole.
- ComfyUI reads each card's page once, and the picture loads from that site. Only public web addresses, never your own machine or network. Off = cards show as plain links.

---

### 🩺 Optimization

**Fast cancel**
- Default: **On**
- Cancel stops a run in a fraction of a second instead of finishing the step first (heavy models, USDU, video).
- Works with every sampler, nothing to wire.

**Free text encoder before sampling**
- Default: **On**
- When sampling starts, any big text encoder (1 GB or more) still in VRAM moves to RAM, so the model gets the whole card.
- Biggest win on H3 and Krea 2. A new prompt reloads it from RAM in a second or two.

**Comfy Optimization Report**
- One button. It pans the canvas by itself for a few seconds, times what every pack in the open workflow draws and runs, and scans their files.
- You get a list of what slows your canvas down, biggest first, sorted into:
    - **That pack's own settings** (the exact setting name, where it lives and its current value)
    - **LC123 optimization settings**
    - **ComfyUI settings**
    - **Sidebar tabs**
    - **Required to function** (no setting, it is how that pack works)
- Only node packs used in the open workflow are analyzed.
- Every setting it suggests is checked against its current value:
    - ⚠️ big gain · ✅ worthwhile gain · 💡 small gain
    - ⚪ already set · ➖ does not apply · ℹ️ required, no setting for it
- **Show last run:** the button at the top flips to the previous report. Each new run also shows what got faster and which fixes are done since last time.
    - Only the last run is kept (it survives a refresh). Each run replaces it.
- Nothing is changed. (Keep the mouse still while it runs.)
- 💡 Also in the right-click menu on the empty canvas.

**System & Model Optimization Report**
- One button. It tests this machine in about 10 seconds: graphics card, VRAM, RAM, page file, drive speed, and which speed-ups really work here (Sage, Triton, Sol-Attn, Comfy Kitchen, fp8 / int8 / nvfp4, llama-cpp).
- ⚠️ problem · 💡 worth changing · ✅ works · ℹ️ info · ➖ not installed
- Then it tells you which model files suit this machine:
    - **Recommended to install:** links to Sage, Triton, Comfy Kitchen etc. for this card when they're missing (links only, nothing is installed)
    - **LC Vision model suggestion** (Quality / Optimal / Fast, with the context size to set)
    - **When picking a model (includes custom models):** what to get for Quality, Optimal and Fast, a size guide, and what to avoid
    - **Model recommendations:** exact files with download links for the tested base models, plus **All base models at a glance**
- **Show last run** and **Copy report** work like the Comfy Optimization Report. It will not run while ComfyUI is generating.
- Nothing is changed. (Also in the right-click menu on the empty canvas.)
- 💡 The **LC Model Optimizer** nodes read this report: run it once and they load the right files and speed-ups for this machine. (With LC Vision installed, its Loader also puts a ★ on the model that suits your card.)

**Node Pack Usage Report**
- One button: **Scan my workflows folder**. It reads every saved workflow (subgraphs too) and shows which installed packs they actually use.
- Lists the packs no workflow uses, the ones only one or two use, and nodes your workflows need that no installed pack has.
- Nothing is changed or uninstalled.

---

### ⚡ Performance

These only change what you see on the canvas. Generation, VRAM, **Save Image** and every **IMAGE** output stay full resolution. (A lighter preview never means a lighter image.)

| Setting | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| **Remove wipe** | Off | Turns off the hover A/B wipe on LC image FX nodes. The last result still shows. |
| **Half-resolution previews** | Off | Draws FX previews at half size. Less work while panning. |
| **Clamp longest side** | Off | Shrinks on-node previews so the longest side fits **Max edge**. |
| **Max edge (px)** | 768 | Only used when **Clamp longest side** is on. Range 256 to 2048. Try 512 on heavy graphs. |
| **No preview when collapsed** | On | Collapsed FX nodes skip drawing their preview. |
| **Hide FX on-node previews** | Off | Hides every LC image FX preview. |
| **Recent colors** | On | Keeps your last 8 custom colors in the right-click **Colors** menu. Adds a Custom picker if Custom Scripts is not installed. |
| **Skin Beauty full preview override** | On | **LC Skin Beauty** keeps a full-quality preview even with half-res or clamp on, so you can still zoom into skin. Wipe still follows **Remove wipe**. |
| **LoRA loader info button** | On | Shows the ℹ button on each **LC LoRA Loader** row. Trigger words come from the LoRA file itself (no internet). Turn off to declutter. |
| **Preview distance (px)** | 40 | Like node text, an on-node image switches off when you zoom out far enough that it is drawn smaller than this. Smaller previews switch off first. 0 = always draw. |

**Never affected:** **LC Image Compare 🔎**, **LC Image Split 🖼️** and **LC Dynamic Overlay** keep their full preview and wipe no matter what (only **Preview distance** switches them off when zoomed far out).

**Suggested setups**
- **Normal use:** leave everything at default.
- **Laggy graph:** turn on **Half-resolution previews** and **Clamp longest side** (Max edge 512). Keep **No preview when collapsed** on.
- **Lightest canvas:** turn on **Hide FX on-node previews**. Use **Image Compare** or **Image Split** when you need to see a before/after.
- 💡 Changes apply on the next redraw. Pan the canvas a little, no restart needed.

---

"True Nothing is. Permitted Everything is"- Yoda Auditore, Assassin's Wars
